core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nazif is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Clean, pure, spotless”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nazif corresponds to the Arabic form نَظِيف (Arabic root ن ظ ف (n-ẓ-f); نَظِيف (Naẓīf)). Its core sense is clean, pure, spotless.
